capabilities.name: National digital ID for apps
capabilities.question: Can an AI agent use a national digital ID or data wallet to prove who a person is to a private app?

US.note: There is no national ID; Login.gov serves only government agencies, and state mobile driver's licenses in Google, Samsung and Apple wallets can be checked by businesses, but only about 20 states issue them.

evidence.title: Login.gov is now accepting mobile driver's licenses
Verify with Google Wallet digital IDs
Login.gov roadmap, August 2026

GB.note: GOV.UK One Login serves central government only and GOV.UK Wallet holds just the veteran card; since 1 September 2026 certified digital verification services can test checks of a sample driving licence in a GOV.UK Wallet sandbox, but it is not a live service, and the national digital ID scheme was dropped in July 2026.

evidence.title: How to access the GOV.UK Wallet sandbox
Using GOV.UK Wallet in the digital identity sector
GOV.UK Wallet - Roadmap for modern digital government
Burnham's move to scrap UK's digital ID plans earns cheers and criticism

DE.note: Any company can accept the Online-Ausweis (eID) after it gets a state authorization certificate or uses a certified eID service; the EUDI wallet 'd-you' is due on 2 January 2027.

evidence.title: Diensteanbieter werden
eID-Service
EUDI-Wallet

BR.note: SERPRO's Datavalid API lets private firms check a person's face and data against official records such as the CNH; the gov.br login itself is open mainly to public bodies.

evidence.title: Nova versão do Datavalid amplia modalidades de validação
Datavalid API Docs
Autenticação Digital (Login Único) - Catálogo de APIs

MX.note: Banks and firms with a signed agreement with INE check the voter credential, the de facto national ID, through INE's data verification service set up in 2016, and vendors such as Veridas also match the person's face against the INE photo; Llave MX and the biometric CURP are not yet open to private apps.

evidence.title: Acuerdo INE/CG92/2016: Servicio de Verificación de los Datos de la Credencial para Votar
INE-Check & RENAPO - General Information
Ni con datos biométricos la CURP desplaza al INE
Lineamientos para la implementación y operación de Llave MX
Identification for Development (ID4D) Global Dataset

CL.note: ClaveÚnica can be used only by private bodies with a signed agreement, such as pension funds (AFP) and e-signature providers, under terms published in November 2025.

evidence.title: Términos y condiciones ClaveÚnica
Gobierno Digital entrega recomendaciones para un correcto uso de ClaveÚnica

CO.note: Banks and other firms check identity against the Registraduría's biometric database through certified operators, and since 2024 banks can also check a face in real time against Registraduría records with the Cédula Digital PIN, a face match or both; Carpeta Ciudadana stays a public-sector service.

evidence.title: Resolución Registraduría 13691 de 2016 (aliados tecnológicos)
BBVA, primer banco en implementar la verificación biométrica en Colombia
Registraduría Nacional pone a disposición del sector financiero tecnología
Identification for Development (ID4D) Global Dataset

IN.note: Aadhaar eKYC and face authentication are open to approved private entities (417 KUAs, about 26 billion eKYC calls in FY2025-26), and DigiLocker lets registered firms pull documents with user consent.

evidence.title: eKYC Dashboard
SOP for submission of applications by private entities

capabilities.name: Government AI service assistant
capabilities.question: Can an AI agent use a government AI assistant to finish a public-service task, not just get answers?

US.note: The IRS voice bot lets taxpayers who prove who they are set up and manage payment plans and make payments, as the Treasury inspector general confirmed in June 2026; IRS web chatbots use set answers, not generative AI, and most state chatbots only answer questions.

evidence.title: Using voice and chat bots to improve the collection taxpayer experience
Privacy Impact Assessment: Taxpayer Services chatbot
Opportunities Exist to Improve the Quality of Chat Applications (Report 2026-308-029)
evidence.publisher: Treasury Inspector General for Tax Administration (TIGTA)

evidence.title: NASCIO Agentic AI Report 2026

GB.note: GOV.UK Chat in the GOV.UK app answers questions from GOV.UK guidance but does not complete tasks; an agent pilot for 16 to 24 year olds is testing next steps, and agentic features are planned from March 2027.

evidence.title: GOV.UK app - Roadmap for modern digital government
AI chatbot fully integrated into GOV.UK app

DE.note: Only city chatbots such as Stuttgart's AI chatbot (in trial) answer questions, F13 and BärGPT serve civil servants only, and Bremen's KOMPASS application helper is due from late 2026.

evidence.title: Chatbot der Stadt Stuttgart
KI-Assistent für das Serviceportal Bremen

BR.note: Chat GOV.BR answers Enem and Sisu questions through WhatsApp notifications and INSS's Helô assistant answers benefit questions; the government says completing transactions by chatbot is the next step.

evidence.title: Governo do Brasil orienta estudantes sobre resultado do Enem pela Caixa Postal GOV.BR
Ministério da Gestão e CPQD fazem balanço de primeiras ações de IA do projeto INSPIRE
evidence.publisher: Ministério da Gestão e da Inovação

evidence.title: MGI aposta em IA para transformar serviços públicos e fortalecer a soberania digital
evidence.publisher: Ministério da Gestão e da Inovação

MX.note: Ventanilla 24/7, the AI assistant on gob.mx and WhatsApp, has been live since January 2026 and helps people find and follow up trámites, but the government plans to let it finish trámites only by 2030.

evidence.title: Ventanilla 24/7, el canal de contacto del Gobierno de México con la ciudadanía, supera un millón de atenciones
evidence.publisher: Agencia de Transformación Digital y Telecomunicaciones (ATDT)

evidence.title: Agenda 2030: Inteligencia artificial
evidence.publisher: Agencia de Transformación Digital y Telecomunicaciones (ATDT)

CL.note: ChileAtiende's generative AI assistant only gives general guidance on trámites and cannot see a person's records or file anything.

evidence.title: Términos y condiciones de uso

CO.note: Robi, the assistant on the GOV.CO portal, guides people on trámites around the clock, and MinTIC announced AI chatbots for requests and complaints in July 2026; neither completes tasks.

evidence.title: Ministerio TIC lanza Robi y GOV.CO 2.0
MinTIC transforma la gestión pública con seis modelos de Inteligencia Artificial para optimizar servicios y procesos institucionales

IN.note: UIDAI's Udai chatbot checks Aadhaar update status and files grievances, and Kisan e-Mitra (built on Bhashini) answers PM-KISAN questions and handles grievances in many languages.

companies.name: UIDAI
companies.role: Runs Aadhaar authentication and eKYC so approved apps can verify a person, and the Udai chatbot for Aadhaar tasks.

companies.name: National e-Governance Division (DigiLocker)
companies.role: Runs DigiLocker and Meri Pehchaan so registered firms can fetch a user's government documents with consent.

companies.name: Digital India Bhashini Division
companies.role: Provides translation and speech models that let government assistants such as Kisan e-Mitra work in Indian languages.

companies.name: Wadhwani AI
companies.role: Built the LLM upgrade of Kisan e-Mitra that answers farmer questions and handles grievances.

companies.name: Government Digital Service (GDS)
companies.role: Runs GOV.UK One Login, GOV.UK Wallet and GOV.UK Chat in the GOV.UK app.

companies.name: Anthropic
companies.role: Supplies the Claude model behind GOV.UK Chat, according to Civil Service World.

companies.name: SERPRO
companies.role: Sells the Datavalid API that lets private apps check faces and personal data against official Brazilian records.

companies.name: Secretaria de Governo Digital (MGI)
companies.role: Runs the gov.br login and builds Chat GOV.BR through the government AI centre.

companies.name: Agencia de Transformación Digital y Telecomunicaciones (ATDT)
companies.role: Runs Llave MX and the Ventanilla 24/7 AI agent on gob.mx.

companies.name: Instituto Nacional Electoral (INE)
companies.role: Runs the voter-credential data and face verification service that banks use to confirm identity.

companies.name: Secretaría de Gobierno Digital (Ministerio de Hacienda)
companies.role: Runs ClaveÚnica and approves which private bodies may use it.

companies.name: ChileAtiende (Instituto de Previsión Social)
companies.role: Runs the generative AI assistant that guides people on state trámites.

companies.name: Registraduría Nacional del Estado Civil
companies.role: Issues the Cédula Digital and lets certified operators check identities against its biometric database.

companies.name: Certicámara
companies.role: Certified biometric operator that connects private firms to Registraduría identity checks.

companies.name: MinTIC
companies.role: Runs the GOV.CO portal and its Robi assistant, plus the public-sector AI chatbot program.

companies.name: Bundesdruckerei (D-Trust)
companies.role: Provides authorization certificates and eID services so companies can accept the German Online-Ausweis.

companies.name: Governikus
companies.role: Runs eID services and the AusweisIDent identification service that plug the Online-Ausweis into private apps.

companies.name: GSA (Login.gov)
companies.role: Runs Login.gov sign-in and identity proofing for US government services, now accepting mobile driver's licenses.

companies.name: Google
companies.role: Lets businesses verify state-issued digital IDs and age from Google Wallet through the Digital Credentials API.

companies.name: Internal Revenue Service (IRS)
companies.role: Runs AI voice and chat bots that answer tax questions and set up payment plans.
